lines.t: Called way-faring men
Preparations made by, alluded to
Often collected together and formed caravans

lines.t: Often engaged persons acquainted with the country as guides
lines.ru: Часто брали в проводники знающих местность

lines.t: Friends of
Often supplied them with provision
Sometimes accompanied them a short way
Frequently commended them to protection of God
Frequently took leave of them with sorrow
lines.ru: Часто прощались с ними со скорбью

lines.t: Often sent them away with music
Generally commenced their journey early in the morning
lines.ru: Обычно отправлялись в путь рано утром

lines.t: Generally rested at noon
Halted at even
Generally halted at wells or streams
lines.ru: Обычно останавливались у колодцев или потоков

lines.t: Carried with them
Provisions for the way
Provender for their beasts of burden
Skins filled with water, wine, &c
lines.ru: Мехи с водой, вином и т. д.

lines.t: Presents for those who entertained them
Often travelled on foot
On foot, how attired
After a long journey, described
Of distinction
Rode on asses, camels, &c
lines.ru: Ездили на ослах, верблюдах и т. д.

lines.t: Rode in chariots
Generally attended by running footmen
Often preceded by heralds, &c to have the roads prepared
lines.ru: Часто перед ними шли вестники и т. д., чтобы приготовить дороги

lines.t: Generally performed their journey in great state
Frequently extorted provisions by the way
Before setting out gave employment, &c to their servants
lines.ru: Перед отъездом давали поручения и т. д. своим слугам

lines.t: Strangers civil to
Generally treated with great hospitality

lines.ru: Упоминается караван-сарай, или общественная гостиница для них

lines.t: Were frequently asked whence they came and whither they went
lines.ru: Их часто спрашивали, откуда они идут и куда

lines.t: Protected by those who entertained them
For security often left the highways
lines.ru: Ради безопасности часто сходили с больших дорог

Went with great speed
Saluted no man by the way

lines.ru: Иудеям запрещалось совершать дальние путешествия в субботу
